q1: SELECT C.NAME FROM CARRIERS AS C JOIN FLIGHTS AS F ON C.CID = F.CARRIER_ID GROUP BY C.CID, C.NAME, F.YEAR, F.MONTH_ID, F.DAY_OF_MONTH HAVING COUNT(F.FID) > 1000
q2: SELECT C.NAME FROM CARRIERS AS C JOIN FLIGHTS AS F ON C.CID = F.CARRIER_ID GROUP BY C.NAME, F.DAY_OF_MONTH HAVING COUNT(F.FID) > 1000

explanation: Q1 groups by C.CID, C.NAME, F.YEAR, F.MONTH_ID, F.DAY_OF_MONTH, while Q2 groups by C.NAME, F.DAY_OF_MONTH. The difference in grouping affects the results when the count of FID for a carrier on a specific day is greater than 1000, but the carrier has different flight years or month IDs.
counterexample_dsp: Create a scenario where a carrier has flights on the same day of the month but in different years and months, with the total flight count on that day exceeding 1000.
